planets.name: WASP-177 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-177 with a 3.07-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: WASP-177 b was found in 2019 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-177. Its orbit and size follow Turner et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
